title: LeBlanche/Quotes
summary:
"That's a fine group of boys she's found, don't you agree, Santiago?"
- LeBlanche to Santiago, (The Casterwill Client )

"The uniforms are nothing if not striking."
-LeBlanche to Sophie Casterwill and Lok Lambert, while they are working in a hotel, (All Work and No Pay )

"Madam, your dog is attempting to assail me!"
-LeBlanche to Alisa Clairmont, (All Work and No Pay)

"Nice moves for a young pup."
-LeBlanche to Lok Lambert, (All Work and No Pay)
